basic_details.job_title: PAU Senior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The PAU Regional Research Station, Faridkot will fill one Senior Research Fellow post in an adhoc cotton project on contract basis, at Rs. 37,000 per month fixed plus 10% HRA, initially for six months or till the project ends, whichever is earlier. Applicants need a B.Sc. and a Master's degree in agriculture or life sciences with specialization in Insect Science. The prescribed form, with a Rs. 200 bank draft, must be received by 07.12.2026; the interview is on 11.12.2026 at 11.00 AM.

how_to_apply: Get the prescribed application form from the office of Director, PAU Regional Research Station, Faridkot.
Deposit a bank draft of Rs. 200 in favour of The Comptroller, PAU payable at Faridkot.
Send the form with self-attested copies of the certificates to the office of Director, P.A.U. Regional Research Station, Circular Road, Faridkot.
Make sure the application is received on or before 07.12.2026.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Self-attested copies of certificates go with the application; originals are brought at the interview. The services of the incumbent are liable to be terminated at any time without prior notice.

content_sections.heading: PAU Senior Research Fellow at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit.

rows.details: Punjab Agricultural University (PAU), Regional Research Station, Faridkot
Dissemination of cotton technologies for enhancing cotton productivity and sustainability (Activity-1) MCP 6.1 ICAR-123 (PC 2831)
Initially six months or till termination of the project, whichever is earlier

content_sections.heading: About PAU
content_sections.text: Punjab Agricultural University, Ludhiana, Punjab, is the university issuing this notice. The post is at its Regional Research Station, Circular Road, Faridkot, and is attached to an adhoc project on cotton technologies.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice gives one set of qualifications for the Senior Research Fellow post: B.Sc. (Life Sciences) / B.Sc. Agri. / B.Sc. Biotech / B.Sc. Hort. / B.Sc. Forestry with minimum OCPA 6.00/10.00 basis or 60%. Master degree in any Agriculture science subject / Life sciences with minimum marks OGPA of 3.40/4.00 or OCPA 6.50/10.00 or 65% marks. Specialization in Insect Science reflected through research publications / Masters research. Candidates having a Post-graduate degree in Basic Sciences with a 3 years Bachelors Degree should have NET and 2 years of research experience. Knowledge of Punjabi up to Matric level. Preference will be given to a candidate having higher educational qualification and experience in cotton insects. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The pay is Rs. 37,000/- per month fixed plus 10% HRA. The post is on contract basis, initially for six months or till termination of the project, whichever is earlier. The services of the incumbent are liable to be terminated at any time without any prior notice.

content_sections.heading: PAU Senior Research Fellow Job Description
content_sections.text: To conduct laboratory and field research work as per objectives of the project. Any other duty that may be assigned from time to time.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for PAU Senior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Get the prescribed application form from the office of Director, PAU Regional Research Station, Faridkot. Deposit a bank draft of Rs. 200 in favour of The Comptroller, PAU payable at Faridkot. Send the form with self-attested copies of the certificates to the office of Director, P.A.U. Regional Research Station, Circular Road, Faridkot. Make sure the application is received on or before 07.12.2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates are to appear before the selection committee for interview on 11.12.2026 at 11.00 AM in the office of Director, Regional Research Station, Faridkot. No separate letter for interview will be issued. Original copies of the testimonials must be brought to the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Self-attested copies of certificates go with the application; originals are brought at the interview. The services of the incumbent are liable to be terminated at any time without prior notice.

faq.question: Q1. How many Senior Research Fellow posts are there at PAU Faridkot?
faq.answer: There is one Senior Research Fellow post in the adhoc cotton project at the Regional Research Station, Faridkot.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must be received in the office of Director, PAU Regional Research Station, Faridkot, on or before 07.12.2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for PAU Senior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: A B.Sc. in Life Sciences, Agri., Biotech, Hort. or Forestry and a Master degree in any Agriculture science subject or Life sciences, with the minimum marks printed, and specialization in Insect Science. Knowledge of Punjabi up to Matric level is also needed.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 37,000/- per month fixed plus 10% HRA.

faq.question: Q5. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice gives the pay as Rs. 37,000/- p.m. fixed plus 10% HRA.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 200, paid by bank draft in favour of The Comptroller, PAU payable at Faridkot.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Collect the prescribed form from the office of Director, PAU Regional Research Station, Faridkot, and submit it there with self-attested copies of certificates and the bank draft by 07.12.2026.

faq.question: Q8. When is the interview?
faq.answer: The interview is on 11.12.2026 at 11.00 AM in the office of Director, Regional Research Station, Faridkot. No separate letter will be issued, and originals of testimonials must be brought.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the post is on contract basis, initially for six months or till termination of the project, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q10. Is TA/DA paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No, the notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
